A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GlowQ research work with readable text, equations, figures, tables and appendices. All 42 page pairs were compared; pages 3–42 match in extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v1 reports original GlowQ and GlowQ-S experiments measuring perplexity, downstream accuracy, latency and memory, with additional ablations and benchmark results in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and the appendices, including the main benchmark comparisons and LongBench evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same shared-factor construction, covariance alignment, QR-reduced randomized SVD, caching and selective restoration. Figure 1's label correction does not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both retain WikiText-2, C4, the seven zero-shot tasks, SlimPajama-6B calibration coverage and the 15 English LongBench subsets with 4K/8K contexts. No dataset or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding main-text and appendix experiments, including BnB, AWQ, GPTQ, ZeroQuant-V2, QERA, L2QER, layerwise correction and exact SVD.

E3.justification: The reported protocols remain identical, including Section 4.1's W4A16 setup, group size 128, rank 64 and 64 calibration sequences of length 2048. Latency procedures and appendix evaluation settings also match.

E4.justification: The whitening/grouping ablations, subspace heatmaps, calibration and rank sweeps, randomized-SVD analyses and restoration-policy comparisons are unchanged in the main text and Appendices B, D and G.

E5.justification: Run information and statistical reporting are unchanged, including repeats=1 in Section 4.3's latency protocol. No seed information, uncertainty estimates or significance tests are added or revised.

E6.justification: All empirical table entries, plotted results and reported findings are unchanged, including appendix results. For example, Table 1 reports GlowQ's LLaMA 3.2-3B WikiText-2 perplexity as 8.16 in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, propositions and derivations in Section 3 and the proofs and guarantees in Appendix A are unchanged. The schematic label correction introduces no mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract's scientific claims, introductory contribution list and conclusion retain the same scope, including the claimed accuracy and efficiency benefits and GlowQ-S trade-off.

C2.justification: Explanations of covariance alignment and caching, selective-restoration trade-offs, calibration costs and applicability remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-availability statement and the ahnselim/GlowQ GitHub repository address to the abstract; v1 contains no corresponding code-access information. Other implementation, hyperparameter and hardware details are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, the bibliography and the positioning relative to prior quantization and low-rank correction research are unchanged. No cited research work is added or removed.

P1.justification: The abstract gains one code-availability sentence, and the arXiv version/date text is updated. The remaining prose, terminology, section organization and appendices are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1 corrects the value-projection error label from E_Q to E_V. The added abstract sentence slightly adjusts the first-page layout; all other figures, tables and subsequent page layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The added repository address provides useful code-access guidance, while Figure 1's corrected label improves consistency with the described method. These are limited practical and presentation improvements; the scientific evidence is unchanged, and repository usability cannot be established from the PDFs.
